class.name: RosTfListener
class.brief_description: A listener for coordinate transforms in the ROS 2 TF2 system.
class.description: [RosTfListener] allows Godot to query the current spatial relationships between different coordinate frames in the ROS 2 TF2 tree. It is created through [method RosNode.create_tf_listener]. By listening for transforms, you can determine the position and rotation of robot parts, sensors, or other objects relative to each other or a global frame.

method.name: can_transform
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a transformation between [param source_frame] and [param target_frame] is currently available in the TF2 tree.

method.name: lookup_transform
method.description: Attempts to find the coordinate transformation from [param source_frame] to [param target_frame]. Returns a [Transform3D] (already converted to the Godot axis convention) representing the position and orientation of the source frame relative to the target frame. Returns [code]null[/code] if the transform is not available, so a failed lookup can be distinguished from a genuine identity transform. If [param timeout_sec] is greater than zero, the lookup blocks for up to that long waiting for the transform to become available (only useful when the executor runs in its default separate thread).
